description:
You are an experienced backend software engineer with solid experience in building reliable services and want to take the next step into the world of AI? Then this role at GuideStream might be a perfect fit.

As a Backend Software Engineer (Remote, Romania), you will work in a small, experienced team on real customer solutions – from integrating modern backend and AI services into existing system landscapes to developing new cloud-based backend components. Occasionally, you will also contribute to frontend development, for example for Human-in-the-Loop interfaces.

Requirements

  • You live in or close to Brasov (an office is planned in the future with a hybrid setup).
  • 7+ years of professional experience in backend development, ideally building and maintaining RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript.
  • Experience in developing and operating enterprise/business applications (e.g. banking, insurance, manufacturing, or similar domains).
  • Solid knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, PostGIS, SQL Server, MongoDB, etc.), including data modeling and query optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and cloud-native services.
  • Practical experience with Docker and container-based development/deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with modern software engineering practices, including Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and testing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, a pragmatic mindset, and willingness to take ownership from design to production.
  • High motivation to learn and work with AI/ML and LLM-based solutions, even if not yet an expert.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with graph and vector databases.
  • MCP development.
  • FastAPI, FastMCP, Agno, LangChain, and LangGraph.
  • Apache AGE, pgvector, and Neo4j.

Responsibilities

  • Context Engineering: design and implementation for RAG systems.
  • MCP development.
  • Data integration.
  • AI agents and workflow development.
  • Prompt engineering.

Technologies

AI, Cloud, Azure, Python, CI/CD, PostgreSQL, GitHub, TypeScript, PostGIS, FastAPI, .NET Framework, Kubernetes, and Machine Learning.
